verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI docs explicitly describe cron-scheduled agents running via the hub that persist across restarts and run independently of any terminal session, plus headless CI/CD execution, chat-triggered agents from Slack/Discord/Telegram/Linear, and autonomous execution with auto-approve/YOLO mode for unattended fixes. This directly matches the always-on, schedule/trigger-driven autonomous maintenance story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the scheduling feature specifically (only vendor docs cited) and detail on failure/retry handling for long-running unattended jobs.
